Downtown Tampa Core.name: Downtown Tampa Core
Downtown Tampa Core.description: Central business district around Curtis Hixon Park with riverwalk towers, office-to-residential conversions, and the Tampa Convention Center spine.

Channel District & Water Street.name: Channel District & Water Street
Channel District & Water Street.description: Water Street mixed-use redevelopment and luxury residential towers on the former ship channel, the metro's densest permit pipeline.

Marina & Tampa Riverwalk.name: Marina & Tampa Riverwalk
Marina & Tampa Riverwalk.description: Ashley Drive marina frontage and riverwalk-adjacent mid-rise infill between downtown and Hyde Park.

Hyde Park Village.name: Hyde Park Village
Hyde Park Village.description: Historic streetcar suburb of bungalow and masonry stock around Hyde Park Village, with teardown/rebuild pressure on large lots.

Bayshore Boulevard.name: Bayshore Boulevard
Bayshore Boulevard.description: Tampa's signature waterfront boulevard with estate-scale homes and consistent luxury renovation permits.

SoHo (South Howard).name: SoHo (South Howard)
SoHo (South Howard).description: South Howard Avenue hospitality and retail corridor with apartment-infill and adaptive reuse of commercial storefronts.

International Plaza & Westshore.name: International Plaza & Westshore
International Plaza & Westshore.description: Westshore business district anchored by International Plaza and Tampa International Airport, with office-to-residential conversion interest.

Tampa Airport & Carrollwood Commons.name: Tampa Airport & Carrollwood Commons
Tampa Airport & Carrollwood Commons.description: Airport-adjacent commercial edge and hotel/warehouse permitting northwest of the Westshore core.

Rocky Point & Bayport.name: Rocky Point & Bayport
Rocky Point & Bayport.description: Rocky Point peninsula resort and office campus with bayfront redevelopment and limited single-family turnover.

Palma Ceia & Swann.name: Palma Ceia & Swann
Palma Ceia & Swann.description: Established south Tampa neighborhood of masonry homes and palm-lined streets with steady renovation permitting.

Gandy / MacDill Access.name: Gandy / MacDill Access
Gandy / MacDill Access.description: Gandy Boulevard corridor and MacDill AFB gateway with light industrial and workforce-housing permitting.

Culbreath & Beach Park.name: Culbreath & Beach Park
Culbreath & Beach Park.description: Bay-front estate pocket southwest of Palma Ceia with low-volume, high-value teardown-rebuild activity.

Tampa Heights & Armature Works.name: Tampa Heights & Armature Works
Tampa Heights & Armature Works.description: Riverfront revival north of downtown around Armature Works with food-hall and mid-rise residential infill.

Ybor City & Historic District.name: Ybor City & Historic District
Ybor City & Historic District.description: Historic cigar-worker district turned nightlife and mixed-use quarter with adaptive reuse and infill townhomes.

Seminole Heights Bungalows.name: Seminole Heights Bungalows
Seminole Heights Bungalows.description: Craftsman-bungalow streetcar suburb with renovation-led permits and Historic District overlay constraints.

Carrollwood & Village Lake.name: Carrollwood & Village Lake
Carrollwood & Village Lake.description: North Tampa suburban lake community with pool-home turnover and scattered teardown-rebuild on large lots.

North Dale Mabry Corridor.name: North Dale Mabry Corridor
North Dale Mabry Corridor.description: Dale Mabry highway spine with commercial-strip redevelopment and garden-apartment infill north of the airport.

Brandon Town Center.name: Brandon Town Center
Brandon Town Center.description: East Hillsborough retail and apartment hub around Westfield Brandon with ongoing multifamily infill.

FishHawk & Lithia (east edge).name: FishHawk & Lithia (east edge)
FishHawk & Lithia (east edge).description: Master-planned exurban edge at the metro's eastern boundary, permitted through Hillsborough County rather than the City of Tampa.
